what_to_detect: An aura swap ability resolves and attaches an Aura card from its controller's hand to the permanent the swapped Aura enchanted.
near_miss: An aura swap ability resolves and attaches nothing.
record_fields: attached / zone_change events of the resolution's effect half
acting line keyword_display_name (a keyword line's script_api_type is Keyword, so api cannot select it)

what_to_detect: An aura swap ability resolves with no effect: its effect half holds no zone_change, because one half of the exchange cannot be completed.
near_miss: An aura swap ability resolves and both cards change zones.
record_fields: zone_change / attached events of the resolution's effect half
acting line keyword_display_name (a keyword line's script_api_type is Keyword, so api cannot select it)
